name: vivo-loyalty
description: Vivo Loyalty — Shopify-connected loyalty PWA (React Router 7 SPA + Fastify + Prisma/Postgres). Single-origin: the API also serves the built SPA.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix the-loyalty-app install && npm --prefix loyalty-app-backend install
scripts.build:web: cd the-loyalty-app && VITE_API_URL_LOYALTY_APP= npm run build
scripts.build:api: cd loyalty-app-backend && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.db:deploy: cd loyalty-app-backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build && npm run db:deploy
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix loyalty-app-backend run dev" "npm --prefix the-loyalty-app run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix loyalty-app-backend run typecheck && npm --prefix the-loyalty-app run typecheck
